stem.text: Which statements about glycosidic bonds are correct?

items: Condensation between glucose and fructose uses water and forms sucrose.
Glycogen contains $\alpha$-1,4 glycosidic bonds and $\alpha$-1,6 glycosidic bonds formed by condensation.
The hydrolysis of amylopectin uses water to break glycosidic bonds and release $\alpha$-glucose.
Amylose contains $\beta$-1,6 glycosidic bonds formed by condensation.
